ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a cumulative curve; the horizontal axis is labeled Demand (in KW), with a range of approximately from 5,000 to 13,000 kW; the vertical axis is labeled Percent of days, with a range from 0 to 100. The curve rises as demand increases. At the position where the demand is approximately 12,000 kW, the corresponding vertical-axis reading of the curve is approximately 97%. Reasoning: The cumulative graph represents the percentage of days for which demand is less than or equal to a certain value. Therefore, the number of days with demand not exceeding 12,000 kW is approximately 97%. The power plant can supply at most 12,000 kW each day, so the days on which it cannot meet demand are the part where demand exceeds 12,000 kW, that is, 100% - 97% ≈ 3%.

raw_record.question_text: The following cumulative graph gives the electricity demand of a certain town. The power plant that provides electricity to this town is capable of generating 12,000 kW daily. On what percent of days will the power plant not be able to meet the demand for electricity?

method.method_draft: Read the cumulative curve at the plant capacity of 12,000 kW. From the image, locate 12,000 on the demand axis, move vertically to the curve, and read the y-value as about 97% of days. From the text, use that the plant can generate 12,000 kW daily and the question asks when demand is not met. Since a cumulative graph gives the percent of days with demand at or below a given demand, the percent not met is the complement: 100% - 97% ≈ 3%.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一条累计曲线，横轴标为 Demand (in KW)，范围大约从 5,000 到 13,000 kW；纵轴标为 Percent of days，范围从 0 到 100。曲线随需求增加而上升，在需求约 12,000 kW 的位置，曲线对应的纵轴读数大约是 97%。推理：累计图表示需求小于或等于某一数值的天数百分比。因此，需求不超过 12,000 kW 的天数约为 97%。发电厂每天最多能供 12,000 kW，所以不能满足需求的天数是需求超过 12,000 kW 的部分，即 100% - 97% ≈ 3%。

method.method_draft: Treat the days the plant cannot meet demand as the upper tail of the cumulative graph. From the image, read the cumulative percent at 13,000 kW as essentially 100%, and read the cumulative percent at 12,000 kW as about 97%. From the text, identify 12,000 kW as the maximum daily generation. The days with demand between 12,000 kW and the top end of the displayed distribution are therefore about 100% - 97% = 3%, so the plant fails on about 3% of days.
